analysis.summary: Maya is an early-career candidate with genuine content and community-building experience, but the Coinbase Experiential Marketing Associate role requires verified event management, vendor coordination, and project management platform skills she does not yet have. Maya Linden
Portland, OR, USA
maya.linden@example.com

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Coinbase

Dear Hiring Manager,

Growing a newsletter audience from 640 to 1,150 subscribers in a single summer taught me that the best marketing moments happen when you give people a clear, compelling reason to show up, and that lesson applies just as much to live experiences as it does to email. Coinbase's experiential marketing team is doing exactly that work: building events that connect the crypto community to something real, and I want to be part of it.

My background sits at the intersection of content creation and audience engagement. At Harbor Street Pet Supply, I helped plan a weekend adoption event that drew around 300 visitors, coordinating logistics, promotional materials built in Canva, and on-site signage from a single intern desk. At Westbrook Film Society, I used Instagram and TikTok to drive screening attendance from an average of 35 to 60 tickets per event, tracking performance through Instagram Insights and iterating on what worked. Neither role gave me Splash or Asana, but both sharpened the instincts that make those tools useful: clear timelines, audience-first thinking, and a bias for follow-through.

I would welcome the chance to talk through how my background maps to what your team needs.

Sincerely,
Maya Linden
